objective: Preregister three candidates for individual-stock opening-range breakout filtered by opening relative volume ('Stocks in Play', Zarattini/Barbon/Aziz SSRN 4729284): SIP01 long-only at the paper's own eligibility parameters, SIP02 long-only at a stricter liquidity floor, SIP03 a long-short diagnostic (not promotable) for implementation-fidelity checking only -- plus a random-direction control (RD) and a random-non-in-play-liquid-stock control (RL), against the design window (2016-2022), the frozen select window (2023-09-18..2025-12-31), and an already-seen 2026 report window, before any backtest is run.

parameters.entry_time: 09:35 ET (stop order placed at range extreme, filled if touched)
parameters.doji_rule: exact open==close in the opening range -> no order (paper's own rule)
parameters.relative_volume_definition: first-5-minute volume on day t / mean of first-5-minute volume over the trailing 14 trading days
parameters.slot_capital_convention: equal split across max_positions (equity_or_buying_power / max_positions per slot, per QuantConnect's replication formula), capped at 1/max_positions portfolio weight per name

data_v1_sip_minute_and_daily_orb_stocks_.source: alpaca SIP minute + daily archives, adjustment=all (fully adjusted)
data_v1_sip_minute_and_daily_orb_stocks_.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume; require >=60 RTH minute bars/session

feature_v1_orb_stocks_in_play_relvol_sel.relative_volume: first-5-minute volume on day t / mean(first-5-minute volume, trailing 14 trading days), per claim_id orb_sip_eligibility_filters
feature_v1_orb_stocks_in_play_relvol_sel.eligibility_filters: candidate-specific price/avg-volume/ATR/relvol floors, see each candidate's parameters
feature_v1_orb_stocks_in_play_relvol_sel.selection: rank eligible stocks by relative_volume descending; take top_n; cross-sectional, computed by a future runner script, not the per-symbol factor engine (same pattern as s3_defense_first_h20260923_12's cross-symbol rank stand-in)
feature_v1_orb_stocks_in_play_relvol_sel.atr14: 14-trading-day average true range from data/sip/daily, used for the eligibility floor and the stop-loss distance

label_v1_orb_trade_outcome_stop_or_eod.definition: per selected name per day: stop-order fill at the opening range extreme (or no trade if not touched or doji), outcome = protective-stop exit (10% of ATR14 from entry) or end-of-session close, whichever comes first; no profit target
